column21: Escalate to Steering Committee to name interim/replacement sponsor; reinforce coalition roster.

column4: Adoption metrics and usage/behavior trend data drift back toward pre-change patterns after hypercare support tapers.
column21: Targeted reinforcement/coaching plan; extend hypercare cadence for affected cohort.

column4: The same employee population is targeted by multiple concurrent initiatives, exceeding its capacity to absorb change.
column21: Sequence or stagger overlapping initiatives; portfolio-level rebalancing at Module 1/4.

column4: An AI-drafted output (score, narrative, coaching script) is distributed or acted upon without the required human review checkpoint.

column21: Enforce Justification Governance and AI human-in-the-loop control; audit AI usage log.

column4: A key influential role (e.g., Chief Medical Officer, plant GM) never joins the guiding coalition, weakening top-down credibility of the change.
column16: Count(required coalition roles not yet on roster)
column21: Direct recruitment outreach by Executive Sponsor to the missing role.

column4: Multiple concurrent initiatives schedule communications to the same population within a short window, causing message fatigue and lower engagement.
column21: Reschedule overlapping sends; consolidate messages across concurrent initiatives.

column4: Champion coverage falls below the target ratio, weakening the peer-support channel and early-warning signal for resistance.
column21: Targeted champion recruitment drive in under-covered departments/sites.

column4: A cohort's UAT/competency scores remain below the pass threshold as go-live approaches, risking day-1 performance failure.
column21: Remedial training assignment and re-test; escalate to Sponsor if unresolved before cutover.

column4: A user role or scope misconfiguration grants visibility into ADKAR, sentiment, or PII data outside the intended reporting line.
column16: Count(access exceptions detected in RBAC audit)
column21: Immediate access revocation and root-cause review of the Permission Matrix / role-scope assignment.

column4: An administrative account is compromised due to missing MFA/SSO or a weak password, exposing platform-wide configuration.
column21: Enforce MFA/SSO rollout; lock accounts after repeated failed logins.

column4: A GDPR-relevant data-subject access or erasure request is not routed or actioned within the statutory window.
column16: Days to action a GDPR request from receipt
column21: Route every GDPR-relevant request to the DPO/Super Admin queue on receipt; track SLA to closure.

column4: Records are retained beyond their defined retention period, or purged before it, creating a compliance exposure.
column21: Automated retention-expiry flagging and Super Admin archival/purge review.

column4: A Real LLM Provider API key is exposed due to browser-storage misconfiguration or a compromised end-user device.
column21: Isolated browser local-storage design; per-user key never transmitted server-side; incident response runbook if reported.
